messages:
Jordan: Following the authz postmortem, opening this thread to track knock-on tasks and owners. Key finding: token validation returned OK for tokens that had been marked rotated due to a race between cache eviction and the async revocation write.
Sam: Can you paste the minimal repro query/log we used in the meeting?
Jordan: Sure, saved in the incident doc. Quick grep for logs: `grep -A3 \"token=\" /var/log/authz/validator.log | grep \"revocation_status=unknown\"` — that pattern lines up with the replay we ran.
Priya: I will run customer-facing rotation. Plan: notify impacted API keys, provide a one-hour rolling rotation window per customer, and enable support hotline. Target window 2026-04-02 22:00 -> 2026-04-03 06:00 UTC. Ticket: INF-4205.
ops-bot: Ticket created INF-4205 by Priya: "Customer token rotation for cache-race cohort"
Maria: I'll own the validator fix: make revocation check synchronous when cache miss occurs, plus add a TTL-check assertion before accept. Expect PR by 2026-03-31. Build and run integration test that simulates concurrent eviction.
Alex: I'll add a CI guard and an automated test harness. CI check idea: a unit test that fails if `validator.use_async_revocation_on_miss()` returns true. Also add an e2e job under infra/ci/e2e/authz_race that runs daily. Due 2026-03-28.
Sam: Security wants full audit traces for token validation paths. Maria, please add structured audit flags `audit.authz.token_check` with user_id, token_id, revocation_flag. Log retention policy update required.
Maria: Adding logs and a switch to toggle verbose audit for a short window. Will include structured JSON logs and ship to log-archive. PR link to come.
sec-bot: Issue SEC-994 opened: "Audit log expansion + KMS key rotation schedule" assigned to Security (team). SLA 21 days.
Jordan: Action item list (owner | task | due):
- Priya | Customer rotation + comms + rollback plan | 2026-04-03
- Maria | Validator sync-on-miss + TTL assertion + audit logs | 2026-03-31
- Alex | CI guards + daily e2e chaos job | 2026-03-28
- Sam | Update postmortem template + add recurrence tag | 2026-03-25
- Security | KMS rotation review + permission matrix audit | 2026-04-10
Priya: For comms, I'll have a short FAQ and opt-in escalation for high-risk customers. Legal review by 2026-03-24 EOD.
Sam: We need a change to the postmortem spreadsheet: add columns "repeat_count" and "systemic_indicator" with links to past incidents. Jordan, can you populate similar incident links?
Jordan: Yes, I'll add links to the two prior incidents and include a short similarity note.
Alex: Can we also add metric churn tracking? Metric: `authz.token_revoked_but_accepted{env=prod}` and `authz.cache_eviction_rate`. If `accepted_revoked_rate > 0.05%` for 30m, auto-open INF-incident and page SRE.
ops-bot: Alert created: authz.accept_revoked_threshold -> threshold 0.0005 -> action: page oncall if exceeded for 30m.
Maria: One integration detail: DB fallback increases latency. We'll gate sync-on-miss behind a feature flag `authz.sync_on_cache_miss` to allow canary rollout. Canary scheduled 2026-03-30 on dedicated-canary-2.
Jordan: Good. Please add the canary plan in INF-4205 and comment on rollback criteria (error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > 200ms).
Priya: Noted. Support runbook will include rollback criteria and customer opt-out steps.
Sam: Long-term items (tickets to follow): 1) default shorter token TTLs for refresh tokens, 2) revocation propagation improvements (fanout to caches), 3) a chaos test that kills cache nodes under load.
Alex: I'll prototype a lightweight chaos job that invalidates a random cache node for 10s during a synthetic QPS run. Put it under infra/chaos/authz_eviction.
Jordan: Thanks all. Let's check status in the Friday sync at 08:00 UTC. If anything slips, update INF-4205 comments. :white_check_mark:
